report_title: # P0024 ARC12 Panel, Stream, Quadrant, and Fractal Development-40 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive development packet measures a bounded P0024 generic-operator portfolio on P0023's immutable fifth disjoint 20 ARC-AGI-1 plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 filename-only cohort. `separated_panel_cellwise_combine` requires three or more equal panels separated by same-color non-background divider lines, learns a finite aligned color-tuple-to-output table solely from visible demonstrations, and returns no value for an unseen tuple. `anti_diagonal_nonbackground_stream` requires a one-row grid with one unique modal background, computes the square side from the visible row width times its visible non-background count, and paints each visible non-background color along its corresponding anti-diagonal; it refuses tied backgrounds and oversized grids. `symmetric_foreground_quadrant_crop` requires a unique-modal-background, even-sized foreground bounding box that is reflective across both axes, and canonically returns its top-left quadrant because all four quadrants are observationally equivalent. `uniform_block_self_stamp_fractal` requires one foreground color, a square non-background crop with perfect-square side length, and uniform foreground/background blocks; it derives the visible meta-pattern and stamps it within every occupied block. P0023's immutable 3/40 source-pinned baseline is the same-cohort pre-change denominator. This is development evidence only, not independent transfer evidence and not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim. The live controller receives only visible training input/output examples and test inputs. It receives no task ID, imported cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or held-out output before committing a complete grid. P0023 baseline bytes and reports remain immutable; P0024 results cannot retune this frozen controller or its operator vocabulary.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: A post-P0023 offline-only failure-family and feature-vocabulary audit motivated four input-derived relations: regularly separated multi-panel combination, anti-diagonal stream expansion, reflective quadrant crop, and uniform-block self-stamping. The controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code.
